They'd suffer more than they do lying around in jail all day, living off my taxes.|Unidentified Pop-Dog corporal and Unidentified Pop-Dog private|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed at [[Chakham Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. During a patrol in the forest near the base with his [[Unidentified Pop-Dog corporal|partner]], they encountered an unidentified creature. The private unintentionally made the encounter more difficult by shining the light of his [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] toward the corporal instead of the creature. After the corporal ordered him to turn off his light, the corporal attempted to speak to the creature in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], and the creature managed to repeat his words, leading the corporal to believe that it was not hostile and was willing to communicate. Thinking it was a drunk [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] visitor on vacation, the corporal contacted his superiors via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to report the situation.<ref name="MK" />

Unbeknownst to the private and his partner, the creature was actually [[Turman Durra]], a member of the recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], who was disguised using a custom grown [[Embass suit|suit]] created with [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bioengineering technology. Durra was working undercover as part of a [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], the leader and founder of the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pop-Dog private was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
